response.justification: While Bogdan possesses over 15 years of solid engineering experience, including handling high-throughput microservices and holding Staff-level titles, his resume lacks the specific domain expertise required for this Principal role. The position is heavily focused on architecting growth and experimentation systems, feature flighting, and telemetry infrastructure. Without demonstrated experience in building experimentation platforms, applying statistical methods, or managing rollout risks, he is unlikely to meet the expectations of an IC6 level engineer in this specific focus area.
strengths: Over 15 years of software engineering experience across multiple languages and paradigms, including Staff-level positions.
Proven capability in handling high-scale, low-latency data systems, such as processing millions of requests per second at Dunnhumby.
Strong technical leadership demonstrated through founding an open-source platform, creating testing frameworks, and organizing technical workshops.
concerns: No visible experience architecting or working on experimentation platforms, A/B testing frameworks, or feature flagging systems.
Lacks demonstrated background in statistical methods, data analysis, or growth metrics which are core to the role.
Most experience is in full-stack product development and GIS rather than foundational developer tools or telemetry infrastructure.
